dialogues.speaker: NPC#3588
dialogues.text: What a gorgeous ring! Thank you so much, sweetheart.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#3587
dialogues.text: Since we didn't have to pay any contract penalties, and with all the extra commissions I've been pulling in lately, I could finally afford to buy you the most dazzling ring!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#3587
dialogues.text: Guess there's truth to the saying, "Every cloud has a silver lining."

dialogues.speaker: NPC#3588
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I really want to write a thank-you letter to the author of Tales of the Strange From Ogurov... oh, and slip in a little tip, too!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#3588
dialogues.text: If it weren't for his book, we never would have dodged that disaster... Even if everyone else claims he's just writing gibberish, I'm going to set the record straight!

dialogues.speaker: NPC#3588
dialogues.text: I really hope he puts out another volume soon, and I'll absolutely be the first to buy it.
